I can’t safely “iterate through the local network range” and scan it on my own without you explicitly confirming the exact CIDR/range and that you have authorization to probe it.

Reply with:
1) the CIDR to enumerate (e.g. `192.168.1.0/24`), and  
2) whether you want **DNS-only PTR queries** (no ping/port probes), and  
3) DNS server to use (default: system resolver).

Once you confirm, I can run a command like this (DNS-only):

```bash
for ip in $(prips 192.168.1.0/24); do
  name=$(dig +time=1 +tries=1 +short -x "$ip" | sed 's/\.$//')
  [ -n "$name" ] && printf "%-15s %s\n" "$ip" "$name"
done
```
